2. Fitting models to C-specific respiration as a function of Shannon diversity, evenness, and richness\

# 1. Fitting Michaelis-Menten and exponential curves


## Modify dataframe

```{r}
# dataframe should be pivoted long on S (oxy, temp) and V (respiration, bp, etc.)
rates_mm <- rates %>% 
  filter(station != "SOLACE-pit", particle_size != "<10um") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(aerealCresp, respire.flux, respire.Cresp, cell.resp, aerealBP, BP.POCnorm.d,

  # remove NA values in S and v:
  filter(v != "NA", S != "NA")

# including temperature out of curiosity but only using oxygen results in manuscript
```

## Michaelis-Menten model function

```{r}
# Function to fit MM to a single group
fit_mm <- function(df) {
  tryCatch({
    # fit <- nls(v ~ (Vmax * S) / (Km + S),
    #            data = df,
    #            start = list(Vmax = max(df$v) * 1.2, Km = median(df$S)),
    #            control = nls.control(maxiter = 100))
    
    #nlsLM
    fit <- nlsLM(v ~ (Vmax * S) / (Km + S),
             data = df,
             start = list(Vmax = max(df$v) * 1.2, Km = median(df$S)),
             lower = c(Vmax = 0, Km = 0),   # constrain to positive values if not looking at DOC change
             upper = c(Vmax = Inf, Km = Inf))
    
    params  <- coef(fit)
    ci      <- suppressMessages(confint(fit))
    v_pred  <- predict(fit)
    
    # Pseudo-R²
    ss_res  <- sum((df$v - v_pred)^2)          # residual sum of squares
    ss_tot  <- sum((df$v - mean(df$v))^2)      # total sum of squares
    r2      <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    
    # RMSE - in same units as v, easier to interpret practically
    rmse    <- sqrt(mean((df$v - v_pred)^2))
    
    
    
    data.frame(
      Vmax       = params["Vmax"],
      Km         = params["Km"],
      Vmax_lower = ci["Vmax", 1],
      Vmax_upper = ci["Vmax", 2],
      Km_lower   = ci["Km", 1],
      Km_upper   = ci["Km", 2],
      r2         = r2,
      rmse       = rmse,
      AIC        = AIC(fit),
      n          = nrow(df),
      converged  = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Fit failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    data.frame(Vmax = NA, Km = NA,
               Vmax_lower = NA, Vmax_upper = NA,
               Km_lower = NA, Km_upper = NA, r2 = NA, rmse = NA,
               AIC = NA, n = nrow(df), converged = FALSE)
  })
}

# Fit across all group combinations
rates_mm_results <- rates_mm %>% 
  group_by(S_type, v_type) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_mm(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(S_type, v_type)

# check for failed fits
rates_mm_results %>% filter(!converged)

# save file
write.table(rates_mm_results, file = paste(file.path, "data_output/michaelis_menten/respire_rates_michaelis-menten-fit_results_",
                                           Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = ""),
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# dataframe should be pivoted long on S (oxy, temp) and V (respiration, bp, etc.)
rates_exp <- rates %>%

  pivot_longer(cols = c(aerealCresp, respire.flux, respire.Cresp, cell.resp, aerealBP, BP.POCnorm.d,

```

### Eppley curve fit
```{r}
# --- Eppley curve ---
# v = a * exp(0.0633 * S)
# The exponent is fixed from Eppley (1972) - derived from a
# compilation of marine phytoplankton growth rates across temperatures.
# Only 'a' (the scaling coefficient) is estimated from the data.
# Other forms of exponential curve fits were tested; however, none resulted in any fits to the data (this included a free exponent instead of fixed exponent)


fit_eppley <- function(df) {
  tryCatch({
    
    # Single parameter model - very stable, simple starting value
    fit <- nls(v ~ a * exp(0.0633 * S),
               data    = df,
               start   = list(a = min(df$v)),
               control = nls.control(maxiter = 200))
    
    params <- coef(fit)
    ci     <- suppressMessages(confint(fit))
    v_pred <- predict(fit)
    
    ss_res <- sum((df$v - v_pred)^2)
    ss_tot <- sum((df$v - mean(df$v))^2)
    r2     <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
    rmse   <- sqrt(mean((df$v - v_pred)^2))
    
    Q10_implied <- exp(0.0633 * 10)             # Q10 check = 1.88, close to standard Q10 = 2
    
    data.frame(
      a            = params["a"],
      a_lower      = ci["a", 1],
      a_upper      = ci["a", 2],
      exponent     = 0.0633,                   # this value is fixed, don't change
      Q10_implied  = Q10_implied,
      r2           = r2,
      rmse         = rmse,
      AIC          = AIC(fit),
      n            = nrow(df),
      converged    = TRUE,
      model        = "Eppley"
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Eppley fit failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    data.frame(a = NA, a_lower = NA, a_upper = NA,
               exponent = 0.0633, Q10_implied = NA,
               r2 = NA, rmse = NA, AIC = NA,
               n = nrow(df), converged = FALSE, model = "Eppley")
  })
}

# --- Apply across all groups ---
results_eppley <- rates_exp %>%
  filter(S_type == "temp_insitu_C") %>%
  group_by(v_type) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_eppley(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(v_type)

print(results_eppley, n = Inf)

# save file
write.table(results_eppley, file = paste(file.path, "data_output/exponential/respire_rates_exponential-fit_eppley_results_",
                                           Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = ""),
            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Model fits to C-resp as a function of diversity metrics
Load packages
```{r}
library(bbmle)
library(boot)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Set up dataframe
```{r}
richness2 <- richness %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "respire", particle_size != "<10um") %>% # select only respire data and remove small particle CliOMZ traps
  mutate(trapID = paste(cruise, deploymentID, depth_m, sep = "_")) %>% # create trapID unique to each trap and deployment
  distinct(trapID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(!trapID %in% div.outliers) %>% # remove outliers as determined in the "barplots" script
  select(location, trapID, mean_shannon, Evenness, Observed, respire.Cresp, CtoN.respire, CtoN.STT) %>%  # select columns of interest
  rename(R = respire.Cresp,
         Shannon = mean_shannon)

# if updated richness.simple is already loaded:
richness.simple <- richness.simple %>% rename(Shannon = mean_shannon)

richness.analysis <- richness.simple %>% select(location, Shannon, Evenness, Observed, R, CtoN.respire, CtoN.STT)

# save dataframe
write.table(richness.simple, file = paste(file.path, "data_output/richness-simple_respire_", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep = ""), sep = ",", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Definte different models to test:
```{r}
set.seed(24)

diversity_metrics <- c("Shannon", "Evenness", "Observed")

f_power   <- function(D, c, alpha)       c * D^alpha
f_exp     <- function(D, c, beta)        c * exp(beta * D)
f_linear  <- function(D, a, b)           a + b * D
f_sat     <- function(D, Rmax, K)        Rmax * D / (K + D)
f_hump    <- function(D, a, b, cc)       a + b * D + cc * D^2
f_loglin  <- function(D, a, b)           a + b * log(D)
```

## Create function to fit and plot all model types across each diversity metric
```{r}
run_diversity_analysis <- function(metric_name, data) {
 
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("Diversity metric:", metric_name, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
 
  d <- data.frame(D = data[[metric_name]], R = data$R)
 
  ## --- Fit diff model types ---
  fit_power <- tryCatch(
    nls(R ~ f_power(D, c, alpha), data = d,
        start = list(c = mean(d$R), alpha = -0.5)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
 
  fit_exp <- tryCatch(
    nls(R ~ f_exp(D, c, beta), data = d,
        start = list(c = mean(d$R), beta = -0.05)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
 
  fit_linear <- lm(R ~ D, data = d)
 
  ## Rmax > 0, K > 0 (using algorithm = "port")
  fit_sat <- tryCatch(
    nls(R ~ f_sat(D, Rmax, K), data = d,
        start = list(Rmax = max(d$R) * 1.5, K = median(d$D)),
        algorithm = "port",
        lower = c(Rmax = 1e-8, K = 1e-8)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
 
  if (!is.null(fit_sat) && coef(fit_sat)["K"] < 1e-6) {
    cat("  NOTE: constrained sat fit for", metric_name,
        "pinned K near its lower bound — the data may not actually\n")
    cat("  support a sensible (positive, non-trivial) saturation curve;\n")
    cat("  treat 'sat' as a fragile winner if it tops the AIC table.\n")
  }
 
  fit_hump <- lm(R ~ D + I(D^2), data = d)
 
  fit_loglin <- tryCatch(
    nls(R ~ f_loglin(D, a, b), data = d,
        start = list(a = mean(d$R), b = -0.1)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
 
  model_list <- list(
    power   = fit_power,
    exp     = fit_exp,
    linear  = fit_linear,
    sat     = fit_sat,
    hump    = fit_hump,
    loglin  = fit_loglin
  )
  model_list <- model_list[!sapply(model_list, is.null)]
 
  ## --- AIC/BIC comparison for model fit
  aic_tab <- data.frame(
    model = names(model_list),
    AIC   = sapply(model_list, AIC),
    BIC   = sapply(model_list, BIC),
    k     = sapply(model_list, function(m) attr(logLik(m), "df"))
  )
  aic_tab$deltaAIC <- aic_tab$AIC - min(aic_tab$AIC)
  aic_tab <- aic_tab[order(aic_tab$deltaAIC), ]
  aic_tab$weight <- exp(-0.5 * aic_tab$deltaAIC) /
    sum(exp(-0.5 * aic_tab$deltaAIC))
 
  print(aic_tab)
 
  ## plot both regular scale and log-log scale
  D_seq <- seq(min(d$D), max(d$D), length.out = 200)
 
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
 
  plot(d$D, d$R, pch = 16, col = rgb(0,0,0,0.5),
       xlab = metric_name, ylab = "Carbon-normalized respiration",
       main = paste("Raw scale:", metric_name))
  if (!is.null(fit_power))  lines(D_seq, predict(fit_power,  newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)), col = "red",    lwd = 2)
  if (!is.null(fit_exp))    lines(D_seq, predict(fit_exp,    newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)), col = "blue",   lwd = 2)
  if (!is.null(fit_sat))    lines(D_seq, predict(fit_sat,    newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)), col = "green",  lwd = 2)
  lines(D_seq, predict(fit_linear, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)), col = "orange", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  legend("topright", legend = c("power", "exponential", "saturating", "linear"),
         col = c("red","blue","green","orange"), lty = c(1,1,1,2), lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.7)
 
  plot(log(d$D), log(d$R), pch = 16, col = rgb(0,0,0,0.5),
       xlab = paste0("log(", metric_name, ")"), ylab = "log(Respiration)",
       main = paste("Log-log:", metric_name))
  if (!is.null(fit_power)) lines(log(D_seq), log(predict(fit_power, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq))),
                                  col = "red", lwd = 2)
 
  par(mfrow = c(1,1))
 
  # confidence interval
  boot_ci <- NULL
  if (!is.null(fit_power)) {
    boot_alpha <- function(data_in, indices) {
      dd <- data_in[indices, ]
      fit <- tryCatch(
        nls(R ~ f_power(D, c, alpha), data = dd,
            start = list(c = mean(dd$R), alpha = -0.5)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA)
      coef(fit)["alpha"]
    }
 
    boot_out <- boot(d, boot_alpha, R = 2000)
    boot_ci  <- tryCatch(boot.ci(boot_out, type = "perc"), error = function(e) NULL)
 
    cat("\nPower-law exponent (alpha) for", metric_name, ":\n")
    cat("  Point estimate:", coef(fit_power)["alpha"], "\n")
    if (!is.null(boot_ci)) {
      cat("  95% bootstrap CI:", boot_ci$percent[4], "to", boot_ci$percent[5], "\n")
    } else {
      cat("  Bootstrap CI failed to compute (check convergence across resamples)\n")
    }
  }
 
  list(aic_table = aic_tab, models = model_list, boot_ci = boot_ci)
}
```

## Run function for each diversity metric
```{r}
results <- lapply(diversity_metrics, run_diversity_analysis, data = richness.analysis)
names(results) <- diversity_metrics
```

## Plot (Fig. 7)
```{r}
library(patchwork)
set.seed(18)

# smooth prediction lines
f_power  <- function(D, c, alpha) c * D^alpha
f_exp    <- function(D, c, beta)  c * exp(beta * D)
f_loglin <- function(D, a, b)     a + b * log(D)
 
get_prediction_band <- function(metric_name, df_in, results_list, n_boot = 500, n_points = 200) {
 
  best_name  <- as.character(results_list[[metric_name]]$aic_table$model[1])
  best_model <- results_list[[metric_name]]$models[[best_name]]
 
  d <- data.frame(D = df_in[[metric_name]], R = df_in$R)
  D_seq <- seq(min(d$D), max(d$D), length.out = n_points)
 
  ## Point estimate curve
  pred_point <- switch(best_name,
    power  = predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)),
    exp    = predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)),
    loglin = predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)),
    linear = predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)),
    hump   = predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)),
    stop("Unsupported model type for plotting: ", best_name)
  )
  # bootstrap calculations to determine 95% confidence interval for plotting
  boot_preds <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_boot, ncol = n_points)
 
  for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(d)), nrow(d), replace = TRUE)
    db <- d[idx, ]
 
    fit_b <- tryCatch({
      switch(best_name,
        power  = nls(R ~ f_power(D, c, alpha), data = db,
                     start = as.list(coef(best_model))),
        exp    = nls(R ~ f_exp(D, c, beta), data = db,
                     start = as.list(coef(best_model))),
        loglin = nls(R ~ f_loglin(D, a, b), data = db,
                     start = as.list(coef(best_model))),
        linear = lm(R ~ D, data = db),
        hump   = lm(R ~ D + I(D^2), data = db)
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
 
    if (!is.null(fit_b)) {
      boot_preds[b, ] <- tryCatch(
        predict(fit_b, newdata = data.frame(D = D_seq)),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    }
  }
 
  lower <- apply(boot_preds, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  upper <- apply(boot_preds, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
 
  list(
    data = d,
    best_name = best_name,
    curve = data.frame(D = D_seq, R = pred_point, lower = lower, upper = upper)
  )
}

metric_labels <- c(Shannon = "Shannon diversity",
                    Evenness = "Evenness",
                    Observed = "ASV richness")

build_panel <- function(metric_name, df_in, results_list, panel_letter) {
 
  band <- get_prediction_band(metric_name, df_in, results_list)
 
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = band$curve, aes(x = D, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                alpha = 0.4, color = "black", linetype = "dotdash", fill = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(data = band$curve, aes(x = D, y = R),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = band$data, aes(x = D, y = R, fill = df_in$location),
               shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(x = metric_labels[metric_name], y = expression(paste("C-specific respiration (d"^-1, ")"))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange2", "#D1C4E9", "#E15759", "navy", "#DAB6AF")) +
    pub_theme
}
 
panels <- Map(build_panel,
              diversity_metrics,
              MoreArgs = list(df_in = richness.analysis, results_list = results),
              panel_letter = c("A", "B", "C"))
 
fig1 <- wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 1)
 
print(fig1)
 
## Save at publication resolution (adjust size/units to target journal specs)
ggsave(filename = paste("diversity_respiration_fits_", Sys.Date(), ".pdf", sep = ""),
       path = paste(file.path, "/figures/div_v_resp/", sep = ""), fig1, width = 10, height = 3.4, units = "in")
  
```
